label: Общините искат още 129.5 млн. евро за местните дейности
text: НСОРБ signed the consultation protocol with the Finance Ministry with categorical disagreement (13 Nov, published 16 Nov) and repeated the demand through the weekend: restore and top up the transfer compensating the minimum-wage rise in local activities to €45.5m — it was €40.5m in 2026 and is deleted outright for 2027 — raise the general equalisation subsidy by €40m to €295.7m, winter road maintenance by €5m to €30.1m, and the capital grant by €39m to €294m. The capital grant was restored at €255m only after being zeroed in the 2 Nov draft, and even so 107 municipalities (40.4%) receive less than in 2026 while 98 get a smaller winter-maintenance transfer; the delegated-activities subsidy is budgeted at €4,626.4m against a demanded minimum of €4,913m, a 6.3% rise that leaves the health function at just +2.8%.
